signals.title: @HeyGurisaroy: Holy Shit... This is a classified spy satellite feed. Every pixel of it is public data. Someone open sourced a browser app that tracks live
signals.content: Holy Shit... This is a classified spy satellite feed. Every pixel of it is public data. Someone open sourced a browser app that tracks live aircraft, ships, satellites, fires, and traffic on a photorealistic 3D Earth. No clearance. No account. No signup. It's called God's Eye View, built by Bilawal Sidhu, the person behind the God's Eye View series that pulled 5M+ views on YouTube. The trick isn't the visuals. It's that none of it is faked. → Click any plane in the sky, drop into its cockpit, and ride it down with real terrain holding underneath you → 13 live layers, 10 of them need zero keys and zero signup: flights, military ADS-B, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, cameras, radio, bikeshare, launches → 800 public traffic cameras projected straight into the 3D city, not embedded webcam boxes → Track the ISS along its real orbit, or drop the entire Starlink shell onto the globe at once → Talk to the planet with 28 voice commands: "how many flights are over Texas right now" and it answers off live telemetry → Reskin the whole Earth through CRT, night vision, or thermal in one tap Enterprise geospatial intelligence usually means a sales call and a contract. This runs in your browser, built from public signals all the way down. The forbidden-looking cockpit was never the hard part. Making it real was. 4.6K stars. MIT License. 100% Opensource. https://t.co/RSHYgqPVse
